query:
UPDATE users
               SET auth_provider = 'google',
                   verified = TRUE,
                   full_name = COALESCE(NULLIF($1, ''), full_name),
                   first_name = COALESCE(NULLIF($2, ''), first_name),
                   last_name = COALESCE($3, last_name),
                   image_url = COALESCE(NULLIF($4, ''), image_url)
             WHERE id = $5
